oneLine: Subway India operator EverBrands filed a DRHP to raise Rs 600 Cr via fresh issue.

sources.title: Subway India operator EverBrands files DRHP to raise Rs 600 Cr via fresh issue

synopsis: Subway India operator EverBrands India has filed a draft red herring prospectus with SEBI for an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of equity shares worth up to Rs 600 crore, with no offer for sale. The company may also consider a pre-IPO placement of up to Rs 120 crore, which would reduce the fresh issue size. Proceeds from the IPO are planned for repaying borrowings and capital expenditure towards setting up new company-operated Subway stores. EverBrands has appointed Motilal Oswal, ICICI Securities, and Nuvama as book-running lead managers for the issue. The company operates Subway stores in India along with managing other food and beverage brands.
